title: Test code and evidence boundaries
description: Read test implementations tests/test_analytics.py, tests/test_fetchers.py. Identify the behavior each assertion encodes, connect it to implementation, and distinguish a test file from an executed passing result. The test/configuration evidence is traced into implementation src/main.py.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in tests/test_analytics.py, tests/test_fetchers.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
